sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Al–Ni binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset AlNi-14Zhu.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L + (Ni) → Ni3Al, lies at 1643.1 K.
The Al–Ni system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as intermetallic rich, order disorder, congruent compound.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry [1], which reproduces the assessment of J. Zhu, M.S. Titus, T.M. Pollock, J. Phase Equilib. Diffus., 35, 595-611(2014). [2].
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
The melting point of Al reproduced by the dataset is 939.4 K.
For Ni, the liquidus meets the axis at 1728.2 K.
At 1643.1 K the peritectic L + (Ni) → Ni3Al takes place; the L phase then contains a mole fraction of 0.759.
At 1642.3 K the eutectic L → NiAl + Ni3Al takes place; the L phase then contains a mole fraction of 0.744.
At 1412.2 K the peritectic L + NiAl → Al3Ni2 takes place; the L phase then contains a mole fraction of 0.261.
Peritectic equilibrium L + Al3Ni2 → Al3Ni is found at 1127.0 K and a mole fraction of 0.160 (L).
The dataset places a peritectoid (NiAl + Ni3Al → Al3Ni5) at 973.4 K; the composition of Al3Ni5 is x(Ni) = 0.625.
At 924.4 K the eutectic L → (Al) + Al3Ni takes place; the L phase then contains x(Ni) = 0.016.
(Ni) melts congruently at 1728.4 K and x(Ni) = 0.988.
Ni3Al melts congruently at 1642.7 K and x(Ni) = 0.751.
Al3Ni5 is stable up to 973.4 K.
The solubility of Al in (Ni) reaches a mole fraction of 0.216 at 1640.0 K.
At 2000 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its minimum, −49.27 kJ/mol, at x(Ni) = 0.500.
The calculated enthalpy of formation of Al3Ni at 298.15 K is −43.45 kJ/mol per mole of atoms.
Its heat capacity at room temperature is 24.46 J/(mol K).
For the equiatomic liquid at 2000 K, the Gibbs energy of mixing is −45.62 kJ/mol-atom.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
